Archive / Research assistance

Research assistance

Ask about a catalogue description, locate a deposited publication or send a documented correction.

Enquiries

Museum of One is the responsible service for the Digital Archive Library. The public research contact is research@museumofone.art.

Include your research topic, the relevant local reference code or DOI, and the question you want to resolve. For a correction, identify the field, propose the corrected wording and link to supporting evidence. Please do not send confidential documents or proposed deposits in an initial enquiry.

Write a research enquiry ↗ Send a catalogue correction ↗

These links open your email application. The archive does not submit a web form, issue an automatic ticket or guarantee a response time.

Before you write

The item register provides reference codes, descriptions, rights and citations. The finding aid explains the selected corpus and local arrangement. The source register identifies the repository and institutional evidence.

Published reading copies are available through item records. Rights to reuse a publication or its third-party material must be checked against the source licence and relevant rights holder. An enquiry does not grant permission.

Future records and sensitive material

Questions about potential future primary records, rights, personal information or access restrictions should identify the material and the reason for the enquiry. No transfer, donation or consent is established by sending an email. Any future deposit requires a separate documented agreement and access assessment.
